text_block_list.text:
—Spring, with pink cherry blossom petals fluttering through the air.
A single reporter arrived at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
thank you for having me today.
choice_data_list: Likewise, I look forward to working with you

text_block_list.text:
We bow to each other, and I invite the magazine reporter into the room.
Now, where is the cleanest spot in here...

I quickly gather the documents and 'notes' from the desk.
...With this seat cleared, it should be fine to show the reporter in.
choice_data_list: Sorry about the mess.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! I'm glad I got to see what the team
is usually like. ――Besides,

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"That notebook over there looks quite well-used.
...How long have you had it?"
choice_data_list: ...Back when I used this notebook—

text_block_list.text:
Tracing the faded cover with my hand,
I recall the days when the "notebook" was still in active use.
Back then, we were immature, inexperienced, and had plenty of naive moments.

Still, I was full of nothing but drive. Clashing with others,
getting worked up. Just recklessly charging forward—
We spent three irreplaceable years together.

Open up the page, and everything from back then
comes flooding back. That was truly our beginning—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Espo-san, congratulations~!
Espon, congrats.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "Haaahn!? What's gotten into you all of a sudden!?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Of cooourse, to celebrate getting your
Make Debut scheduled♪ You're debuting
around the summer, right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco's debuting this year too!
We're forming a fabulous debut-class unit☆"

—Smart Falcon. She is an "Umadol"
Umamusume who absolutely loves live concerts.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Mm-mm, truly a joyous occasion.
Espo-n finally got herself a Trainer, huh~

Transcend is a subculture-savvy informant
who runs in search of thrills,
and is a classmate of Espoir City.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...I can't even imagine.
Just what kind of person could be Espo-san's Trainer...

"And fellow classmate Furioso is a special exchange student from Funabashi,
vowing to defeat the Central League.
She's a prodigy who even conquered the G1 Zen-Nippon Nisai Yushun."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Tch! Who cares
who the Trainer is?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Come on, of course I'm curious~!
You met through that... "Project K" thing, right?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "Project K"... That was the secret training camp held at Kokura Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I've heard that mischievous girls are
more likely to be invited as participants, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I wanna know how that all went down~
Hey, so how did you end up teaming up with your Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Not really... It's nothing.
Trainers and trainees form pairs, and...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...I was the one who picked her up!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Picked it up?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: “Yep. Because she was a total greenhorn and completely hopeless~.”

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "On the flip side, I'm such a crazy-strong Umamusume that I don't even need a Trainer, so I'm the one looking after him! End of story!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you bastards, scatter!
Training's about to start, ain't it?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "If you're gonna whine and get in my way, I'll give you something to rattle about, dammit!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah...!
What incredible presence...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...I can picture it vividly.
Espo-san showing up with that same attitude even in front of her trainer.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, yeah, I guess so~...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Please, let us debut without breaking up!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —Shaah! Let's get fired up, let's gooo!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(I'm gonna bring my A-game today!
After all, it's my first training session since my debut race was decided...!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'll show 'em!
What I'm really made of...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: This sound is...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Mom.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...'I'm always cheering you on.
Love, your biggest fan, Mom'...?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Stop sending me stupid messages.
I already know that.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...You don't need to worry about your daughter. She's strong, dammit.
Full-scale training finally begins today. I open my notebook and wait for my assigned Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you!
Are you ready, Trainer?!
choice_data_list: Espo!

text_block_list.text:
Espoir City, my "trainee Umamusume."
I first met her during "Project K"... at a special training camp held at Kokura Racecourse.

She and I were two people who had been
forcibly paired together back then.
However, learning that she wanted to get stronger for her mother's sake, you earned her trust and signed an official contract—

...Ordinary coaching won't do; I must guide her with a custom "textbook."
In other words, I coach her while keeping a dedicated notebook.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Don't you dare slack off during training, you bastard!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Mom and that damn old man are definitely gonna watch my debut!
I'm gonna blow everyone away right from race one!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's live up to your parents' expectations too!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huuuh?!
choice_data_list: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Idiot!
As if that old bastard would ever have high hopes for me!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
She's...! Even though she's supposed to be a trainer at a development club...!
She made me...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "...Tch, anyway! That damn old man is garbage! Got it!?"
choice_data_list: O-Okay, got it! — ...So that's how it is, huh?
O-Okay, got it! — ...Oh, I see.

text_block_list.text:
Unlike when facing her mother,
she now radiated an aura of outright anger.

It's probably best if I don't bring up the topic of her father.
I make a new note in the margin of my "textbook."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, you still carry that thing around?
Your 'textbook', was it?
choice_data_list: Yeah! I'll use this to coach you properly!
Yeah! I'll give you proper guidance based on this!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hah... relying on books?
You really are a fledgling, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
......I mean,
for a textbook, doesn't this look way too much like a notebook?
Who handed this down to you?
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Textbooks with visuals like that ain't sold in normal stores, right? So...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? I got it!
It's like a notebook your master used, right!?
For training Umamusume!

I'm taken aback by the sudden remark.
This "textbook" didn't have any special history,
like being handed down by someone.

"This is just for my personal use,
notes on my strategy against Espoir City that I'm in the middle of writing..."
choice_data_list: (But now they've got these weird expectations of me...)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, look at that face. Hit the nail on the head, didn't I?
Right!?"
choice_data_list: Uh, ummm... Ah! Something like that!
Uh, ummm... Yeah! Something like that!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Then right now, I'll show you
something that isn't in any textbook.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: The power of your own super-duper strongest trainee Umamusume, dammit!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Urrrryaaaaaaahhhh—!!

And then, Espoir City
took off in a full sprint! Her time was—
choice_data_list: (...Not bad at all!)

text_block_list.text:
That looks like a solid time for someone who hasn't debuted yet.
However, her form during acceleration is still a bit unrefined.
choice_data_list: (I need to fix this before it becomes a bad habit... All right.)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haa..., haa...!
Well, Trainer... are ya terrified yet...!
choice_data_list: Espo, stop running and come back!
Espo, stop running and come back!

text_block_list.text:
I give instructions to Espoir City.
First, let's teach her how to shift her center of gravity when accelerating.
She needs to face what the problem is directly—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Haaaah~~~~!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Don't talk back! Half-assing and quitting your run?!
That's so pathetic...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I'm not gonna let yaaaaaaa!
choice_data_list: Huh—!? Espo—!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... *wheeze*...
This is my... absolute fastest...!

In the end, Espoir City ignored the instructions and kept on accelerating.
...Pushing herself so recklessly that she ended up completely out of breath.
choice_data_list: Um, Espo? ...Do you have a moment?
Um, Espo? ...Got a second?

text_block_list.text:
...A good beginning makes a good ending.
I must ensure she properly understands
the rationale behind the instructions I just gave.

"If she doesn't build a proper foundation now, it's the future
Espoir City who will suffer. That's why I must teach her
with the utmost care—"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
choice_data_list: ...Espo?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
…………She's way faster over there……
……Everyone else too――……
(Kyaaaaa--!!)

text_block_list.name: Nearby Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Amaaazing! Did you see that?!
Tap Dance City's running on a totally
different level!"

text_block_list.name: Nearby Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: And Gold City getting that close was insane, right?! Even the way she runs is so gorgeous...

text_block_list.name: Nearby Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Haa... amazing..."
"Haa... so cool..."

On the track next over were some powerhouse turf Umamusume,
including Tap Dance City, who had set Japan ablaze
with her daring runaway victories.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: …………Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Let me do that!!
Give me some crazy training too, dammit!!
choice_data_list: Huh? Given your aptitudes, rather than a turf course—
Huh? With your aptitude, you'd be better on dirt than turf—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Don't you dare underestimate meee!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Stop grumbling!
Look, I'm a "City" too!
I'm just like Tap and the others... aren't I?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Or what?
You underestimating me, thinking I can't pull it off?
Huh?"
choice_data_list: No, that's not it...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Then do it! Right now!
I'm a strong Umamusume, after all!!

"Now that we've formed a contract, it's become even clearer to me
...the problems Espoir City faces."
Will I really be able to craft the perfect "textbook" from now on to guide such a strong-willed, rebellious girl?

Our Twinkle Series with Espoir City
began with a touch of unease.
